title: Faster receiving with shared pictures and clearer quantities

sections.title: Receiving checklist
items: Show existing catalogue pictures with the shared centered picture editor, collaboration rail, action artwork and table styling.
Open stock adjustments and zero-cost overshipped receiving from the item actions. Expected units must be accounted for before a separate zero-cost receipt.

sections.title: Receipt entry
items: Focus expiration date when receiving opens and return focus to checklist search after a successful receipt.
Enter cases, units per case and any loose units. Total units are calculated and read-only across sellable stock, exceptions and expiration batches.
Keep invoice quantities, original costs, reservation protection and receipt audit history intact.

title: Shared inventory, safer order checks and consistent tables

sections.title: Inventory synchronization
items: Calculate affected seller-fulfilled SKU quantities from shared catalogue stock, including multipacks, bundles, reservations, adjustments and shelf-life rules.
Queue quantity changes durably, prioritize zero stock and verify Amazon responses. Inventory sync shows calculated quantities, retry status and local simulation results.
Add informational ledger notes when nearby orders through different SKUs share the same catalogue item.

sections.title: Pending orders and cancellations
items: Recheck unresolved orders individually, including payment-pending orders older than 30 days. Missing orders remain reserved and are flagged for review; age alone never releases stock.
Confirmed cancellations release reservations with a ledger explanation, without adding physical stock. Older status responses cannot overwrite a newer cancellation.
Partial shipments deduct only the newly shipped portion and keep the remainder reserved. Missing shipment stock history holds related SKUs at zero until the remaining stock is counted.

sections.title: Consistent operational tables
items: Use the shared picture, collaboration, action and mapping design across Orders, Marketplace SKUs, inventory, catalogue, vendors and receiving.
Save account-based tagged smart filters with dynamic dates and show filtered order, unit and sales totals without expanding summary cards.
Use shared picture editing and vendor logos, compact mapping dialogs, four-week sales summaries and consistent currency formatting.
Keep packing-slip reprints available and use the approved action artwork.

title: Approved Orders table and action design

sections.title: Orders table
items: Keep product pictures and collaboration/actions together in the Overview column, with the approved status and SKU mapping artwork.
Reorder columns with a clear drop indicator and read centered, larger numeric values and currency symbols.
Use clearer empty states and compact Orders/Units counts.

sections.title: Actions and attention
items: Stock Shortage and Unmapped use attention colors and short reason tags. Buy Box Lost remains a regular review tab without alerts or priority sorting.
Use consistent optimized action artwork and platform confirmation dialogs. Amazon product links remain shortcuts outside the Actions menu.
Hide the platform-only awaiting-pickup notice once Amazon confirms shipment.

title: Clearer order icons and connected conversations

sections.title: Orders workspace
items: Recognize order status faster with larger consistent icons and orange Pending and Unshipped badges.
Open SKU mapping through a clearer button beside item codes, with separate mapped and unmapped artwork.
Use product-picture actions, Amazon shortcuts and a more visible packing-slip action while retaining the existing row colors and image layout.

sections.title: Connected collaboration
items: Conversation icons distinguish empty, active and personally related conversations, with counts for open conversations.
Order conversations remain linked to their origin and appear in gray on related SKU, catalogue and inventory records.

title: Clearer receiving quantities and expiration batches

sections.title: Receiving improvements
items: Receive multiple expiration batches and independent damaged, short-shipped and mispick quantities in one save.
Compact quantity summaries, progress colors and standard warning dialogs make receiving easier to review.
Item fees return to the receiving draft, and location creation uses the shared storage-location dialog.

sections.title: Accurate inventory and catalogue updates
items: Overage requires confirmation and remains separate at zero acquisition cost. Undo preserves history and correctly restores expected quantities.
Case-pack changes now require an explicit catalogue update; editing receipt quantities does not change the shared product case pack.

sections.title: Receiving workspace
items: Receive all open documents when none are selected, or receive multiple selected documents together.
Document and receipt colors distinguish open, partial, closed, short-shipped and damaged stock. Received expiration dates follow your configured shelf-life warning rules.
Review and undo eligible receipt decisions, including shortages, with audit history preserved. Closed documents remain read-only.

sections.title: Faster receipt entry
items: Use a compact form with cases, units per case, total units, location and expiration. Case size and expiration requirements are saved to the catalogue for future receiving.
Add an unmatched item to the catalogue from receiving. Use the standard collaboration icon instead of a separate Notes field.

sections.title: Inventory hotfix
items: Open the same sliding inventory detail by clicking a sold-out catalogue item’s title in Available Inventory, and review its complete movement history even when no current stock batch remains.

sections.title: Inventory hotfix
items: Adjust inventory from Marketplace SKUs, Account Catalogue, and Available Inventory using one expiration-aware, location-aware action.
Search Available Inventory for catalogue items with no stock and add their first inventory position without leaving the page.
Receive any catalogue item from Invoices & packing lists with a required explanation and a permanent zero-cost receipt in the inventory ledger.

sections.title: Pictures and speed
items: Upload or change an item picture from its inventory details using a small picture-overlay action.
Catalogue and mapping pickers show product pictures and use focused item queries that remain fast with large catalogues.

sections.title: Inventory hotfix
items: Close receiving documents containing historical undated receipts that are already recorded in inventory. New stock still requires an expiration date when applicable.
Upload or change a product picture directly from Available Inventory details. Pictures are saved to your Account Catalogue.

sections.title: Shelf counts and order reservations
items: Upload shelf counts excluding packed orders. Open-order reservations are recalculated, and shipped orders no longer appear as actionable stock shortages.
Missing inventory records for shipped orders are explained in the ledger without reducing newly counted stock.
Physical count offers your latest three uploads and supports dates such as 5/16/27.

sections.title: Easier inventory corrections
items: Edit expiration dates beside inventory rows. Matching item, location and date positions combine, with correction history preserved and reservations refreshed.
Order inventory adjustments use the expiration date you enter, creating that date’s stock position when needed.
Manage vendors and locations from Available Inventory. Edit or delete unused locations, with detailed explanations when records prevent changes.

sections.title: Clearer everyday tools
items: Right-click product pictures to sync Amazon’s main image into Account and Global Catalogue.
Dates display as MM/DD/YY, while native date pickers follow browser settings.
Order action menus remain visible on short tables. Physical-count reviews scroll with accessible approval controls, and inventory dialogs use consistent styling.

sections.title: Packing-slip hotfix
items: If your browser blocks the second tab, the packing page now shows step-by-step Chrome instructions for allowing this site and a direct link to open your Seller Central order.

sections.title: Invite your team
items: Send store invitations from info@nextaicommerce.com. Invitations identify who invited you, and replies go to info@nextaicommerce.com.

sections.title: Pack and complete orders
items: Open the packing label and Seller Central order together from the packing-slip button. Allow pop-ups for this site to open both tabs; if a tab is blocked, the packing page explains how to open Seller Central.

Mark an order shipped from the packing page to place it in Waiting for pickup in this platform. The packing tab closes after saving, and Orders refreshes when you return while keeping your place. This does not confirm shipment in Amazon.
When completing the last matching orders, exhausted search and column filters clear so you can continue with other orders in the same tab.

sections.title: Clearer order tools
items: Copy SKUs with the familiar copy icon and see full SKU, ASIN and item-code values immediately on hover.
Spot missing SKU mappings in the warning menu and open mapping directly from the table.
Read four-week sales in refreshed colored bar charts. Clear Filters stays disabled until a filter is active.

sections.title: Complete order history
items: Guarded startup recovery refreshes the last 30 days of orders when no recent full check has completed.
Finished setup jobs no longer block scheduled history refreshes, and unsuccessful imports no longer advance the successful sync position.
History reports and live order updates reuse matching items to prevent duplicate sales. Amazon inventory, listing and pricing changes remain disabled.

title: Accurate order times and clearer shortcuts

sections.title: Orders
items: Amazon US order and last-sync times now show Pacific time, including the PDT or PST label.
Click an Amazon order number to open that order in Seller Central. The Amazon Seller icon opens Manage Inventory for the item's ASIN.

title: Release notes without leaving your work

sections.title: A clearer release history
items: Open the version button to read release notes in a right-side panel. Back or Close returns to the same page without losing your place.
A blue dot marks a new deployed version until you open its notes. Your read state is remembered for your account in this browser.
Choose among the five latest releases, or browse all documented deployments at the bottom of the panel.
The release panel works in light and dark appearance and adapts to smaller screens.

title: Clearer connection errors and complete packaging history

sections.title: Marketplace connections
items: Unreadable saved credentials now show an action-required message instead of appearing healthy.
Re-enter your credentials to verify Amazon access and the selected marketplace before replacing the saved values. Imported orders and inventory are retained.

sections.title: Packaging history
items: The supplied packaging history is now available in production, while existing order-level choices are preserved.
Save a package for an order to reuse that choice for future orders with the same ASINs and quantities. Orders with their own saved choices keep them.

sections.title: Orders at a glance
items: See four weeks of SKU sales alongside your orders to help plan fulfillment.
Click an ASIN or item-code button to filter the table; click again to release it. Full codes appear on hover, and active filters are easier to spot and clear.
Larger, uncropped product pictures keep collaboration and relevant actions together without duplicate menus.

sections.title: Packing made simpler
items: Choose and save packaging for an ASIN and quantity combination, then print a compact 2 × 1 label with up to two items per page.
Labels show product brand, packaging, quantities, item details, expiry and location without unnecessary footer links.
For UPS, Medium and OMBox packaging, open Veeqo directly and automatically copy the order ID, ready to paste.

sections.title: Inventory and receiving
items: Clearer action menus explain stock warnings and guide you to the appropriate inventory task.
A smaller product-mapping dialog shows search progress, offers product creation when nothing matches, and prevents incomplete bundle lines.
Receiving menus and disabled selections are easier to read in dark mode. Open invoices offer a close action; closed invoices no longer offer inappropriate actions.

sections.title: Quieter refreshes and release history
items: Buy Box prices refresh no more often than every three hours, with gentler request spacing and longer pauses if Amazon asks us to slow down. Order updates continue independently.
Release highlights explain changes in everyday language.

sections.title: Everyday operations
items: Consistent tables and marketplace shortcuts across catalogue, inventory and order workspaces.
Clearer inventory movement history, location selection and download progress.
Improved catalogue search and readable table layouts.

sections.title: Everyday operations
items: Work with marketplace orders, available inventory and receiving in one account-aware workspace.
Manage marketplace connections, catalogue mappings and team access.
